Definition: to be translucent; figuratively, to be innocent
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be clean, be pure, be clear; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be clean, be pure; 1a2) to be clear, be justified; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to make clean, make pure, keep clean, keep pure; 1c) (Hithpael); 1c1) to cleanse; 1c2) to make yourself clean, purify oneself
